verdict.rationale: The evidence has no native versioning, review, or rollback for New Relic automations such as alert rules, notification routing, or automated remediation. The only related signals are a declarative Terraform path for managing agent fleets, which could be kept in git for review and rollback, and NerdGraph's ability to configure some features programmatically, which could support a do-it-yourself config-as-code workflow. Missing for 10: built-in version history for alerts/workflows/remediation automations, review/approval flow, one-click rollback, documented Terraform/IaC coverage of alerts and workflows, and hands-on corroboration.
